api.name_in_use: The connection «{value}» already has this name
api.dest_format: Enter the site as host:port, e.g. www.microsoft.com:443
api.dest_no_reality: This connection has no REALITY camouflage

api.domain_invalid: A domain like vpn.example.com, or empty
api.support_url_invalid: The link must start with https:// or tg://
api.name_blank: The name cannot be empty or start/end with spaces
api.name_bad_char: No commas, quotes or control characters
api.name_reserved: This name is built into mihomo (DIRECT, REJECT, GLOBAL…)

api.group_alias_taken: The name {value} is taken by a service group, pick another one
api.groups_same: The groups must have different names
api.group_is_proxy: The connection «{value}» already has this name
api.acme_disabled: Certificates are not issued in this mode
api.config_type: Type «{value}» is not supported. Allowed: vless, vmess, trojan, hysteria2, tuic, anytls
api.config_key: Field «{value}» is not supported for this type
api.config_managed: mikan fills in «{value}» itself — remove it
api.config_insecure: Unencrypted is not allowed: add reality-config or mikan.tls: node
api.config_both_tls: REALITY and mikan.tls: node do not work together — pick one
api.config_flow: flow: xtls-rprx-vision is only for vless over TCP
api.config_xhttp_mode: mode: stream-one, stream-up or packet-up (auto hangs in mihomo)
api.config_masquerade: masquerade must be https:// to a public site
api.config_obfs: obfs needs obfs: salamander and obfs-password
api.reality_dest_private: dest cannot be an internal address: only a public site or the panel's own port

api.scan_busy: A search is already running — wait for it
api.scan_no_ip: Could not find the server's IPv4 — check the address in the settings
api.bad_dest: host:port of a public site is required
api.local_node: This is the panel's own node: its address is set in the panel settings
api.nodes_disabled: Nodes are unavailable: the panel runs without nodes

acme.port80_busy: Port 80 is used by another program — Let's Encrypt checks the server through it
acme.rate_limited: Let's Encrypt temporarily limited issuance (too many reinstalls) — we will retry later
acme.unreachable: Let's Encrypt could not reach the server on port 80 — check the firewall
acme.no_public_host: A public IP or domain is required

login.subtitle: Sign in to the control panel
login.totpHint: Enter the 6 digits from your authenticator app or one of the recovery codes.
login.badCode: The code did not match. Check the time on your phone and try again.
login.tooMany: Too many failed attempts. You can try again in {s} s.
login.forgot: Forgot the password? On the server run

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.nodeUnreachable: The panel could not reach the node. If users' VPN works, check the «node» container:
dashboard.safetyNote: Clients cannot reach the server's local networks; outgoing mail (port 25) is blocked.
dashboard.attentionSub: expiring, over the limit or already expired
dashboard.attentionEmpty: No subscriptions ending within the next week.
dashboard.topSub: since the start of the month
dashboard.topEmpty: Statistics will appear once users start connecting.

users.emptyText: Create the first one — the subscription link and QR code appear right away.
users.notFoundQuery: Nothing matches «{q}». Check the spelling or reset the filter.
users.notFoundGroup: Nobody is in this group right now.
users.keyboardHint: A row opens the card · space selects it
users.subtitle: {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {active} with an active subscription
users.deleteText: Their links stop working immediately and the statistics are deleted. This cannot be undone.

userCreate.title: New user
userCreate.meta: The subscription link appears right after creation
userCreate.name: Name
userCreate.nameHint: Only you and the client's subscription page show it.
userCreate.nameRequired: Enter a name — it makes the user easier to find
userCreate.contactHint: Optional: @telegram or a phone number to find them quickly.
userCreate.tariffHint: Term, volume and device limit come from the plan — you can change them in the card.

userDrawer.reissueText: The old link and every device on it stop working immediately. You will need to send the new link to the user.
userDrawer.reissued: Done: the old link no longer works
userDrawer.deleteText: The link stops working immediately and the traffic history is deleted. This cannot be undone.
userDrawer.switchText: Limits come from the plan and the term starts again from today. Used traffic is kept.
userDrawer.noHost: Set the server address in the settings to get a link.
userDrawer.sendHint: Send the link to the client or let them scan the QR code in the app.
userDrawer.noDevices: No connections yet. A device appears here after the first sign-in.
userDrawer.devicesNote: A device is an IP address with an active connection. Its place frees up a minute after it disconnects.
userDrawer.needOneProtocol: At least one protocol is needed — otherwise disable the user
userDrawer.notePlaceholder: E.g.: pays via Telegram, renew on the 1st

tariffs.subtitle: Templates for granting access in one click. Changing a plan does not touch subscriptions already issued.
tariffs.emptyText: Create a template — e.g. «Standard: 150 GB for 30 days, 3 devices».
tariffs.archiveText: New users cannot be created with it. Nothing changes for those who already have it.
tariffs.name: Name
tariffs.whenResetHint: For multi-month plans: the volume is granted again every period.
tariffs.priceHint: Only a label in the panel — there are no payments in the panel yet.

presets.vless_reality_xhttp: Main one for Russia: looks like plain HTTPS and keeps few connections
presets.hysteria2: Fast on poor links, runs over UDP
presets.tuic_v5: A QUIC alternative, also over UDP
presets.vless_reality_vision: For old clients without XHTTP. Gets frozen quickly on 443 in Russia
presets.vless_reality_grpc: HTTP/2 with multiplexing: few connections, a different traffic pattern
presets.trojan_reality: Another protocol under the same camouflage — a fallback
presets.anytls: TLS with padding against packet-size analysis; needs a mihomo or sing-box client
presets.custom: A mihomo listener template in the editor: any supported type and parameters

inbounds.subtitle: Protocols clients use to reach the server. Keys and passwords are generated automatically.
inbounds.reconnectWarning: Changing the port or camouflage reconnects this protocol's clients for a few seconds. Hysteria2 and TUIC take longer — up to 30 seconds.
inbounds.emptyText: Without them clients cannot connect. Start with VLESS REALITY XHTTP — it works best in Russia.
inbounds.deleteText: Clients using this protocol lose the connection until they switch to another one. Subscriptions update by themselves.
inbounds.errPortBusy: The port is used by another program on the server. Choose another port or free this one.
inbounds.errPermission: No permission to open this port. Check the container settings.
inbounds.newMeta: Keys, passwords and paths are generated automatically
inbounds.portHint: Default {port}/{network}. Hysteria2 accepts a range, e.g. 20000-20100.
inbounds.saved: Saved — clients get the changes when their subscription updates
inbounds.subNameHint: Clients see the connection under this name. Emoji are fine: «🇳🇱 Netherlands». Empty — the default name.
inbounds.destHint: A site with TLS 1.3 and HTTP/2, ideally in the server's network. From outside, client traffic looks like visits to this site.
inbounds.destLocked: The config was changed on the «Config» tab — change the site there too.
inbounds.customMeta: A mihomo listener template: mikan fills in users, port and certificate
inbounds.configHint: mihomo listener format. name, port, listen, users and the certificate are filled in automatically. Ctrl+Space shows field hints.
inbounds.portHintCustom: A free port: TCP or UDP depends on the type in the config.
inbounds.customSkeleton:
# mihomo listener template. mikan fills in name, port, listen,
# users and the certificate. Types: vless, vmess, trojan, hysteria2, tuic, anytls.
type: trojan
ws-path: /ws
mikan:
  tls: node   # the node certificate, like Hysteria2 and TUIC
inbounds.targetScanning: Looking for sites in the server's network — up to 30 seconds…
inbounds.targetNone: No suitable sites near the server (addresses checked: {scanned}). Keep a popular site or set the server's domain in the settings to get self-steal.
inbounds.targetSelfStealHint: self-steal: the SNI matches the server's IP, the panel's Let's Encrypt certificate
inbounds.targetSni: Clients will send SNI {sni}. Save to apply.

targetErr.timeout: The site did not answer in time

inbounds.nodeEmptyText: Add protocols — they appear in the subscription with the node's flag.

settings.subtitle: Server address, subscription look and sign-in security
settings.hostHint: The IP address clients use to connect to the VPN.
settings.domainHint: Optional. When set, links use it instead of the IP.
settings.quietHourHint: Once a day at this hour the slot pool is maintained: Hysteria2 and TUIC clients briefly reconnect.
settings.subscriptionSub: How the profile looks in clients' apps
settings.brandHint: The profile gets this name in clients' apps.
settings.groupAutoHint: The group that picks the fastest connection by itself.
settings.previewHint: This is how clients see the subscription in Koala Clash and other Clash apps. Connection names are set under «Protocols».
settings.routingHint: For Koala Clash, FlClash and other mihomo apps. Happ and INCY route traffic on their own.
settings.routingRuDirectSub: Russian sites and IPs bypass the VPN by mihomo geodata: banks and state services work, and the server does not carry that traffic.
settings.routingAllSub: All traffic except the local network goes through the server.
settings.supportHint: A Telegram or website link — the «Contact support» button on the subscription page.
settings.adminLinkSub: Any other address on this port answers «404 Not Found».
settings.newLinkHint: If the link leaked. The old one stops working.
settings.newLinkText: The old one stops opening in a few seconds and we switch to the new one right away. Save it — without it you can only sign in through the server (mikan url).
settings.certRequested: Certificate requested — it takes up to a minute
settings.certSelf: Self-signed: browsers warn, and some apps will not accept the subscription
settings.certNote: Renews automatically. Issuance needs port 80 open — it is held for a few seconds.
settings.newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. A phrase of several words is handy.
settings.twoFactorOn: On: signing in needs a code from the app
settings.twoFactorOff: A code from an authenticator app at every sign-in
settings.recoveryText: Save the recovery codes — each works once if your phone is not at hand. We will not show them again.
settings.totpQr: QR code for the authenticator app
settings.totpScan: Scan the code in Google Authenticator, 1Password or Aegis and enter the 6 digits.
settings.sessionsSub: Where the panel is open now

sub.loadFailedText: Check your internet and reload the page. If it does not help, contact whoever gave you the link.

status.limited: Traffic for this period has run out

notes.bestWindows: Best for Windows: all traffic and routing

3.text: Allow adding the configuration if the phone asks.

nodes.subtitle: Servers that run the VPN. The subscription includes the protocols of every enabled node, each in its own group.
nodes.emptyText: The panel's own node appears here once it starts.
nodes.localOffline: The panel cannot see its own node. Check on the server: mikan status.
nodes.remoteOffline: The panel cannot reach the node. If it was just added, install it with the command from its key; otherwise check that the server is up and the API port is open.
nodes.rekeyText: The old key stops working at once: the node is disconnected until mikan join runs on its server with the new key.
nodes.deleteText: The node stops serving clients and its protocols leave the subscriptions. To clean up the server itself, run mikan uninstall on it.
nodes.newMeta: A server that will serve VPN for this panel
nodes.name: Name
nodes.nameHint: The group in the subscription. A leading flag prefixes its protocol names: «🇺🇸 VLESS XHTTP».
nodes.hostHint: The panel connects to the node at this address, and clients connect to its protocols.
nodes.domainHint: Optional. Used instead of the IP in Hysteria2 and TUIC links.
nodes.apiPortHint: The panel connects to the node on this port over key-checked TLS.
nodes.keyOnce: The key is shown once. If you lose it, issue a new one on the node's card.
nodes.keyStep1: Copy install.sh and the mikan image to the node's server — as when installing the panel.
nodes.keyStep2: Run the command below, adding --image-tar FILE or --image IMAGE.
nodes.keyStep3: In half a minute the node shows up here as «Working».
nodes.localAddress: The own node's address is the panel's address; change it in the settings.
nodes.servingHint: A disabled node accepts no connections and leaves the subscriptions.
nodes.nameLocalHint: Name your own node with a flag, e.g. «🇳🇱 Netherlands»: that is its group in the subscription, and the flag prefixes its protocols.
